column2: Pony Trail Print Reversible Cotton Quilt (Razai)
column3:
Little ponies trot across this quilt in their own tiny jackets — the kind of print a child who loves anything with four legs won't want to put down.

Block-printed with little ponies wearing tiny jackets, trotting across a sage-teal ground, finished with a citrus-lime striped edge. Made from soft cotton voile with a hand-quilted cotton fill and skin-safe, azo-free dyes — gentle enough for daily use from day one.

It works as a full kids quilt for younger children, and just as well as a stroller blanket, play mat, or nursery décor throw — then a lightweight travel or AC blanket as your child grows, from newborn to the early teens.

Hand block-printed in Jaipur, one wooden block pressed at a time, so no two quilts carry quite the same pony — flip it over for a coordinating teal-and-white stripe. 110 x 150 cm.
